# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

I’m calling about an order I placed. Some things changed in my life, and I don’t really need several of the items anymore. I was hoping to cancel the hiking boots, watch, keyboard, charger, jacket, and running shoes.

If it’s not possible to cancel just those items, that’s okay — you can just cancel the whole order instead.

I’d really appreciate your help.
james_kim_7213

To cancel anything, I first need to know which order you want me to work on. Your account has these orders:

- #W9154975
- #W3289292
- #W7284266
- #W9722559

Please tell me the order ID. Once you do, I’ll check whether it’s still pending and whether I can cancel the whole order. If it’s not pending, I won’t be able to cancel it.

Thanks. I’m not sure which one it is, sorry.

Could you please check the order that includes the hiking boots, watch, keyboard, charger, jacket, and running shoes? That should be the one I need cancelled.

If you can’t look it up that way, I can try to figure it out, but I was hoping you might be able to see which order has those items.
